question: Find the area of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 10 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Side length of the equilateral triangle (a) = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = (√3 / 4) × a²

**Calculations:**

Area = (√3 / 4) × (10 × 10)

⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × 100

⇒ Area = 25√3 cm²

**∴ The area of the equilateral triangle is approximately 25√3 cm2.**
